title: SpecLLMOutput
description: What the LLMRouter must return when it turns a citizen report into a spec (stage `spec`, text model). This is the raw model answer, validated with Pydantic before anything is stored. It is never stored as is: the orchestrator merges it with the catalog row (see report_spec.schema.json). All values are English. Unknown keys are a validation failure (one retry with the error, then next provider).

category_id.description: One id from the active catalog list given in the prompt, or `other`. An id that is not in the list is treated as a validation failure.

domain_id.description: Optional. Only read when the category belongs to more than one domain (domain_categories). Ignored if the pair (domain_id, category_id) does not exist.

summary_en.description: One short English sentence describing the problem and the place. Never copied into a brief.

severity.description: Model's severity proposal, 1 (minor) to 5 (danger to life). The final reports.severity combines it with deterministic signals.

entities.description: Optional structured details the text mentions. Free strings are short and English.

landmark.description: Named place near the problem, e.g. `Mercado Mayorista`.

sam_prompts.description: Up to 4 short English noun phrases (1 to 5 words, lowercase letters, spaces and hyphens) describing what the problem looks like in a photo. Added to the catalog target_prompts, never replacing them. Phrases that fail the pattern are dropped, not the whole answer.

photo_verifiable.description: Only used when category_id = `other`: false turns photo_verifiability into `none` for this report.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Below 0.40, the keyword result is preferred if the keywords found a category.

contains_personal_data.description: True if the text includes names, phone numbers, plates or other personal data. The orchestrator then never shows raw_text outside the device that wrote it.

examples.summary_en: People wait for the bus at a corner far from the official stop near Mercado Mayorista
